summary: The big news is Moonshot Collect. Jupiter Gacha went live inside the Moonshot app on 17 Nov, with Apple Pay buying through MoonPay and pulls you can keep, sell back or ship, plus a free pack a day until 24 Nov. Lots of creators posted about it at the same time, so it looks like a paid push. Solflare Packs got a handful of small posts from Breakpoint and creators saying they ripped packs. On the mainstream side, scalpers and PSA wait times came up again, and Taiwan's Pokémon stamps sold out in 26 minutes.
